title: #434 Mental Awareness
prompt: What is your opinion on the importance of mental health awareness in schools?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Mental health education helps students manage stress.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mental health education helps students manage stress.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Mental health education helps students build strong friendships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mental health education helps students build strong friendships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Students already learn about feelings from family and friends in daily life, making special school lessons unnecessary.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Students already learn about feelings from family and friends in daily life, making special school lessons unnecessary.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Adding mental health topics would overload the school day, distracting from core academic subjects like math, science, and history.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Adding mental health topics would overload the school day, distracting from core academic subjects like math, science, and history.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Mental health awareness helps students recognize early signs of emotional problems.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mental health awareness helps students recognize early signs of emotional problems.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Mental awareness also reduces the stigma around talking about mental health issues.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mental awareness also reduces the stigma around talking about mental health issues.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Schools should focus on academic subjects rather than spending too much time on mental health education.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Schools should focus on academic subjects rather than spending too much time on mental health education.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Overemphasis on mental health awareness can negatively affect students' focus and willingness to learn academic material.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Overemphasis on mental health awareness can negatively affect students' focus and willingness to learn academic material.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

modelPlan.focus: The essay will argue the importance of mental health awareness in schools by highlighting its role in fostering resilience, reducing stigma, and enhancing academic performance.
keyArguments: Mental health awareness helps reduce stigma and encourages students to seek help.
It improves academic performance by addressing stress and anxiety.
